specific_prose_corrections: Each list first names what 0/1 records and gives left-to-right indices. Four-position tables bridge neighbor reads to simultaneous, immediate and reverse-order updates.

The payoff table names self rows and opponent columns, both averaging stages and 1/T units. Continuous count growth and quotient differentiation explain the replicator factor rather than just defining it.
Type codes and activation indicators have distinct meanings. Local payoff endpoints use one actual neighbor; an outside zero is not a fictitious type-0 individual.

Neutral repetitions are 300 independent one-generation samples. Indicators derive the frequency variance p(1-p)/N; fixed input arithmetic separates expected probability from finite offspring frequency.

Selection uses dimensionless per-generation weights. Mutation direction indices, processing order and 80×30×200 shared input coordinates are defined. The shaded band is the empirical 10%–90% quantile range.

Diffusion starts with paired transfers, then spatial first slopes and second differences. A common one-cell volume connects U/格 values to total U. Cell-centered no-flux endpoints exchange only with their internal neighbor.

The nondimensional reaction model retains gamma in 1/T. Equilibrium, Jacobian and discrete sinusoidal growth connect to mode evidence; coarse temporal agreement and failed spatial refinement remain different findings.

Distance-two c2 is a joint proportion, not a Pearson coefficient. Periodic spatial connectivity is distinguished from a temporal period-two orbit. Mean-field substitution and exact one-step density are separately derived.
Block density preserves counts and positions at the block scale but loses within-block ordering. Exact next-density aggregation does not establish complete p/c2 multi-step closure.

Exercises state rules without relying on a preceding question. Final option reading aligns type language, avoids universal old/new mixing claims at the last asynchronous position and names indices rather than ambiguous ordinal positions.
The three web views explain their actual lengths, steps, payoff rate units and endpoint reads while retaining controls and numerical computations.
